parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against the human single-protein target CHEMBL236 (Delta-type opioid receptor). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, target type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax ID 9606, standard type IC50, standard relation equals, and pChEMBL value not null. Order rows by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
